classification.difficultyReason: Count twos in varied equal-sector spinners and simplify each complementary probability.

content.prompt: Calculate $P(\text{not }2)$ for each of these spinners as a simplified fraction.

spec.description: Seven-sector circular spinner; clockwise from the upward boundary: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. No pointer.
spec.mathematics: Seven equal angular sectors, as supported by the source drawing and approved editorial decision. Exactly one sector is labelled 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Sector labels are student-visible givens; the supplied probability is answer-only.

spec.description: Circular spinner with four quadrants; clockwise from upper right: 2, 2, 7, 6. No pointer.
spec.mathematics: Four equal quadrants; two are labelled 2.
spec.answerVisibility: All quadrant labels are givens; probability answer excluded.

spec.description: Flat-topped hexagon divided into six triangles. Clockwise from top: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 2.
spec.mathematics: Regular hexagon with six equal central sectors, consistent with the approved interpretation. Four sectors are labelled 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Sector labels are givens; probability answer excluded.

spec.description: Flat-topped hexagon divided into six triangles. Clockwise from top: 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3.
spec.mathematics: Six equal central sectors; two sectors are labelled 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Sector labels are givens; probability answer excluded.

spec.description: Seven-sector circular spinner; clockwise from the upward boundary: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4. No pointer.
spec.mathematics: Seven equal angular sectors; exactly one is labelled 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Sector labels are givens; probability answer excluded.

spec.description: Green circular spinner with four quadrants, each labelled 2. No pointer.
spec.mathematics: All four sectors are labelled 2; its complement is impossible.
spec.answerVisibility: All four labels are givens; probability answer excluded.
